checklist.detail: Resultant injection beta angle +4.1 deg is outside the -4 to +2 deg band LOX/LH2 prefers - it wants a slightly negative beta (~0 or below). Adjust the impingement angle or element momentum ratio.
checklist.name: Injector resultant beta angle

checklist.detail: At the throat, combined hoop + thermal-restraint stress (Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall) is ~973 MPa (hoop ~45 MPa from a ~12.4 MPa net jacket-vs-gas differential + thermal-restraint ~928 MPa) against a ~67 MPa allowable (Stainless Steel (304/316), SF 1.5), with the wall at its minimum-stress thickness ~0.20 mm. This uses a real handbook stress formula (Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall), not a proxy - worth a closer structural look. The thermal-restraint term dominates and grows with wall thickness (dT = q*t/k), so the wall is already at its ~0.2 mm minimum - consider a higher-conductivity liner (a copper alloy such as GRCop-84/NARloy-Z) or less throat heat flux (film cooling, lower Pc).
checklist.name: Jacket overpressure vs. channel-wall structural margin

checklist.detail: n/a - no compression tangent-modulus (E_c) data for Stainless Steel (304/316); see ASSUMPTIONS.md

checklist.detail: A single cooling tube must taper 7.8:1 along its run - past SP-8087's 6:1 limit for a swaged (3:1) + expanded (2:1) tube. Add a tube bifurcation (Tube split area ratio) so the tube count doubles downstream.
checklist.name: Tube taper within swage/expand limit (SP-8087)
